brief:
Hundreds of Tunisians protested in Tunis demanding the release of four Global Sumud Flotilla activists, Al Jazeera English reported. The demonstration reflects continuing support in Tunisia for the activists, who remain in detention.

The Global Sumud Flotilla has organized efforts to break Israel's naval blockade of Gaza. The four activists' imprisonment has drawn calls for their release from civil society groups across the region.
dek: Hundreds of Tunisians have protested in Tunis, demanding the release of four Global Sumud Flotilla activists.
title: Tunisians demand release of jailed Gaza flotilla activists
